text:
A good start for understanding your communication style, your unique structure of personal strength, and your own way to get energized.
Individual PCM Consultations
Book a consultation
Situations clients bring

You don’t need to know anything about PCM. People come with real communication situations they want to understand or improve.

"I feel misunderstood in conversations. Sometimes it hurts so much when the relationship is important"
"I want to communicate more effectively as a leader. I notice that different people in my team respond very differently to the same message"
" I want to know myself better. I'm curious about my communication style and how I can develop it further"
"Certain interactions drain me. Communication with some people is exhausting or tense, and I don't understand why"
"Why people are so f.. serious!? Life is fun!"
"We with N. react differently under stress. In difficult moments, communication becomes more emotional or distant, and it is hart to reconnect"
Types of consultations
Individual

Deep dive in yourself, superpowers and their sources to be discovered

For couples/partners

Best way to discover each other for deep understanding and supportive connection

For leaders

Take it to the next level by combining your strengths with those of the people around you

PCM profile and debrief - how does it work

Are you curious about your personal PCM profile? Look what you get in the session:

Practical insights for real-life situations

Explore your communication experiences through the PCM lens and gain practical insight.

Clarity about your personality

Understand your PCM profile and the unique structure of your personality

Insight into how you communicate

Discover your natural way of interacting, perceiving the world, and connecting with others

Understanding your motivation and stress patterns

Learn about your psychological needs and how to stay balanced and energized. 

Practical insights for real-life situations

Explore your communication experiences through the PCM lens and gain practical insight.

Clarity about your personality

Understand your PCM profile and the unique structure of your personality

Book your session
Step 1
You fill out the PCM questionnaire online
Step 2

You will get a 26-page personal PCM profile when we meet, online or in person (in case you are in Tallinn). Session duration is 1,5-2 hours

Step 3

A follow-up after a month after the session. A chance to revisit you profile, share what you have noticed in practice, ask questions and deepen your practical using of PCM.

Testimonials
Thanks to PCM profiling, I can now understand why sometimes (quite often, actually) it is so hard for me to say "no". And I am now much better at it! Choosing myself consciously and keeping much better balance between me and the demanding world...
I did the training with my employees. We got to know each other better and realised that our personalities are a perfect match. This knowledge improves communication and makes us more successful!
Now I have the tools to adapt to different communication styles and avoid unnecessary conflicts. Special thanks for your energy and ability to explain complex things in simple language. It was not only informative, but also really interesting!
My personality profile proved to be unexpectedly insightful and prompted me to reflect on and analyze my life circumstances.
Join Us
Take the First Step Towards Transforming Your Communication Today!
Get Started
